description:
Turn your living room into a drone delivery playground. Drone Arena is a spatial flying game built for Apple Vision Pro, where your real space becomes the course. Pilot a tiny courier drone, grab cargo crates with a claw gesture, and haul them across your home.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Delivery Mode: Mark out Cargo, Doorway, and Delivery zones around your room, then race the clock. Critter clients pop up requesting specific crate sizes, doorway scanners slow you down, and multi-stop routes keep every run tense. Structured, arcade, endlessly replayable.

Sandbox Mode: No timers, no fail state. Packages of every size spawn in front of you. Grab, stack, toss, and drop them with playful physics: crates wobble, bounce, and burst open with confetti. Pure toybox calm for couch play.

FEATURES

- Your room is the level, built on Vision Pro spatial tracking
- Intuitive claw-grab and flight controls that work the same in both modes
- Timed delivery missions with critter clients and doorway events
- Relaxed sandbox with satisfying package physics
- Unlock new crate types, skins, and silly physics toys as you play
- Pick up right where you left off, one session at a time

Strap in, line up your approach, and make the delivery. Welcome to the arena.
promotionalText: Your living room is the runway. Fly a courier drone, grab cargo with a claw, and deliver across your real space. Race the clock or chill in sandbox.
